principle: retain identifiable or potentially linkable research data for the shortest period needed to validate the needs analysis; preserve longer-term evidence only as genuinely anonymised aggregate outputs and integrity hashes

schedules.allowed_content: security/availability metadata only; request bodies, form answers and raw Idempotency-Key MUST NOT be logged
schedules.target_retention: 7 days maximum unless a documented security necessity requires shorter/exceptional retention
schedules.gate: hosting configuration must be verified before collection

schedules.data_class: raw and normalised analytical respondent records
schedules.retention: until needs-analysis validation and application evidence freeze, then delete no later than 180 days after primary collection closes
schedules.hard_stop: 2027-03-31 unless a documented legal claim/audit hold approved by the controller requires a narrower retained subset
schedules.post_deletion: retain only anonymised aggregates, disclosure-controlled tables, source/provenance metadata and cryptographic integrity hashes that cannot be used to reconstruct respondent records

schedules.content: opaque derived response_id + canonical body digest only; no raw key
schedules.retention: same lifecycle as the corresponding analytical respondent record
delete after the requested follow-up is completed and in all cases no later than 90 days after primary collection closes
schedules.post_deletion: no contact identifier is copied to NF06 or analysis evidence

schedules.data_class: immutable primary export used for NF06 validation
schedules.retention: same respondent-level hard stop as analytical records
schedules.control: encrypted/restricted evidence location; SHA-256 retained after deletion; export itself deleted at hard stop

schedules.classification: NON_EVIDENCE / synthetic=true / no real personal data
schedules.separation: must never share PROD evidence namespace or promotion path

deletion_evidence_required: row/object counts before and after deletion
confirmation that backups follow provider expiry and cannot silently restore live respondent records
confirmation that optional contact store and PROD analytical store were both checked

exceptions.legal_hold: must be documented by controller with scope, reason, approver, start date and review date; blanket indefinite retention is forbidden
exceptions.processor_backup_limit: must be documented before go-live; if provider cannot meet the intended deletion lifecycle, collection remains NO_GO
